name: Ouija Board
overview: Scripture clearly forbids any involvement with familiar spirits, wizards, and divination practices, as seen in Leviticus and Deuteronomy where God commands His people to avoid such occult activities to remain undefiled. The severe consequences for engaging in these practices, including being cut off from the community or even death, highlight the gravity of turning to spiritual mediums like the Ouija board. The New Testament warns that willful sin after knowing the truth leaves no sacrifice for forgiveness, underscoring the need for believers to reject occult practices and cling to Christ alone for guidance and truth.
